title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: amount still open on a demurrage line for goodwill
content:
## Scope

When commercial goodwill is considered on the demurrage invoice line of a per-container record under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this rule fixes the amount still open on that line.

## Rule

The amount still open on the demurrage line is its amount less every waiver and dispute credit already booked with that line as the invoice line they refer to.

## How the figure is taken

1. The demurrage amount invoiced is the amount of the demurrage invoice line booked on the record.
2. The earlier reductions are every waiver and every dispute credit already booked against that same demurrage line, whoever granted them.
3. The amount still open is the first figure less the second, and it is never taken below nothing.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Demurrage line as invoiced | USD 800.00 |
| Earlier waiver booked against the line | USD 100.00 |
| Earlier dispute credit booked against the line | USD 50.00 |
| Amount still open | USD 650.00 |

## Points of judgement

**Q: A payment was made on the record. Does it reduce the amount still open for goodwill?**
A: No. Only waivers and dispute credits booked against the demurrage line are taken off; payments are not among them.

**Q: A credit was booked against the detention line. Does it count here?**
A: No. Only reductions booked against the demurrage line count.
